title: MergePlan
description: Durable merge plan emitted by the merge-pull-requests analysis round and consumed by plan-driven execution. Separates plan DEFINITION (nodes, edges, strategy, gates) from plan LIVE STATE (outcome, claim, verdict, inserted blockers).

storage_tier.description: Which tier is authoritative for live state. 'file' in Phase 1; 'coordinator' when the coordinator is the system of record (Phase 2).

auto_executable.description: True only for low-risk nodes (dependency bumps, trivial fixes) with no human gate. Proposal-acceptance and admin-override nodes are always false.

definition.description: Snapshot fields — reviewable/diffable; a live-state update SHALL NOT rewrite these.

depends_on.description: PR numbers this node depends on (file-overlap or base-branch edges). Must form a DAG: JSON Schema enforces per-node edge uniqueness via uniqueItems; cross-node invariants (each `pr` unique across nodes, every edge target present as a node, no self-dependency, no cycles) are producer-enforced — see contracts/README.md.

inserted_reason.description: Present when this node was inserted mid-execution as a discovered prerequisite (living-plan amendment).

needs_revalidation.description: Set when an upstream node merged into base; execution must recompute mergeability before merging this node.

claimed_by.description: Executor identity holding this node (multi-host claim). Null when unclaimed.

unresolved_comments.description: Count of unresolved review comments on the node. 0 until analysis records it; 'unknown' state is not applicable to a count.

unresolved_comment_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the unresolved review comments the comment-addressing seam records on the node (spec: 'SHALL record the unresolved-comment summary'). Null when there are none or none have been summarised yet.

vendor_verdict.description: Result of vendor_review.py for this node (confirmed/unconfirmed/blocking counts); null until reviewed.

blocking_reason.description: Why the node could not be merged (e.g. 'failing required security check').
